title: LibScript Build Execution Plan
description: Deterministic, topologically sorted linear build execution plan generated by the constraint solver

plan_version.description: Semantic version of execution plan schema format

profile_name.description: Identifier of the originating profile configuration

target.description: Target architecture, libc, and operating system attributes

arch.description: Target CPU architecture (e.g. x86_64, aarch64, riscv64)

libc.description: Target standard C library runtime (e.g. glibc, musl, bsd-libc, nolibc)

os.description: Target operating system family (e.g. linux, freebsd, unikraft)

compiler.description: Selected C compiler toolchain for kernel and target compilation ('default', 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', 'edgcpp', 'custom-cc')

stages.description: Ordered sequence of execution stages to be processed linearly

items.description: A single logical build execution stage containing sequential tasks

stage.description: Identifier of the build phase or lifecycle stage (e.g. stage0-host-tools, stage1-cross-tools, stage2-target-sysroot, stage3-kernel-image)

description.description: Human-readable explanation of this execution stage's purpose

tasks.description: Topologically ordered tasks to execute within this stage

items.description: Single task specification within a stage

name.description: Component or package identifier for this task

component.description: Relative filesystem path to component recipe directory (e.g. _lib/base-system/glibc)

action.description: Execution action to perform (e.g. compile, bootstrap, assemble, package)

stamp.description: Deterministic stamp filename used for tracking execution idempotency

items.description: Enabled feature variant name (e.g. wayland, pipewire, nls)

variants.description: List of active USE flag variants enabled for this task

env.description: Environment variable overrides injected into this task execution

license.description: SPDX license expression for this task component (e.g. GPL-2.0-only, MIT, Apache-2.0)

license_name.description: Human-readable name of the software license

license_file.description: Relative filesystem path to component's local license text document

is_bundled.description: Indicates whether component payload is physically bundled into installer distribution

logical_resources.description: Collection of logical resources (e.g., virtual hosts, logical databases, runtimes) to be provisioned on top of physical shared components

items.description: A logical resource definition mapping to a physical provider

type.description: Type of logical resource being provisioned

virtual_hosts.description: Virtual host routing configuration mapping domain/port bindings to the shared Reverse Proxy component

server_name.description: Domain name or IP address for the virtual host

listen_ports.description: Array of ports the virtual host listens on (default [80, 443])

document_root.description: Optional document root path for static assets

routes.description: Path matching rules for routing requests

target.description: Upstream target address or fastcgi socket

logical_databases.description: Database provisioning mapping CREATE DATABASE and users to shared physical MariaDB/PostgreSQL components

db_name.description: Name of the logical database to create or utilize

db_user.description: Username with privileges to the logical database

runtime_isolation.description: Environment isolation configurations defining venv or node_modules paths originating from shared Runtime components

base_runtime_ref.description: Reference to the underlying physical runtime component installation

configuration_parameters.description: User-selectable configuration inputs (or properties) to override default provisioning behaviors (e.g. local vs remote)

preferred_reverse_proxy.description: Preferred reverse proxy engine for multiplexing (nginx or apache2)

db_strategy.description: Strategy for database provisioning: utilize local shared component or connect to remote/managed database

db_host.description: Host address for remote database connections

db_name.description: Custom logical database name overriding the default

db_url.description: Full connection string or URI for remote databases

traits.description: Ordered list of node-level traits applied to LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_SYSROOT or the live host

items.description: Trait identifier (e.g. storage, secrets, firewall, mesh, discovery, tls, ingress, logging, metrics, backup, maintenance)

tenant_provisions.description: Declarative logical multi-tenant provisioning entries executed via hooks/provision_tenant

component.description: Target multitenant _lib component hosting the logical resource

db_name.description: Logical database or schema name to provision

db_user.description: Database role or user granted access to the tenant schema

server_name.description: Virtual host domain name routed via netctl

deps.description: Flat dependency map specifying component names to version strings

^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$.description: Requested semantic version or 'latest' for the dependency

services.description: Declarative application service daemon definitions (supports object map or array of service objects)

command.description: Command line executed to launch the service

working_dir.description: Working directory relative to the manifest directory

env.description: Environment variables injected into the service runtime

env_files.description: List of dotenv files sourced before starting the service

items.description: Relative or absolute path to an environment file

port.description: Primary TCP port exposed by the service for fallback readiness polling

user.description: System user account under which the service runs and owns stateful data

health_check.description: Declarative service health check command or HTTP/JSON verification specification

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS endpoint URL polled to verify service readiness

command.description: Custom shell command executed in the service working directory to verify health

expect_status.description: Expected HTTP status code returned by the health check URL (defaults to 200)

expect_json.description: jq boolean filter expression evaluated against the HTTP JSON response body

retries.description: Number of polling attempts before declaring the service unhealthy

interval.description: Delay in seconds between consecutive health check polling attempts

timeout.description: Per-request timeout in seconds when polling the health check URL

databases.description: Declarative database and cache instances to initialize and wire into the application environment

engine.description: Database engine identifier (postgres, mysql, sqlite, duckdb, valkey)

name.description: Logical database name or file path

user.description: Database role or user to create

path.description: Filesystem path for embedded database engines such as DuckDB or SQLite

min_tables.description: Minimum number of user tables required in the database for health checks to pass

required_tables.description: List of table names that must exist and contain rows for health checks to pass

min_rows.description: Minimum row count required across required_tables (integer or per-table map)

additionalProperties.description: Minimum row count for the specified table name

seed_file.description: Path to a SQL script file executed during database provisioning

seed_dir.description: Directory of SQL, CSV, or Parquet files imported during database provisioning

migration_dir.description: Directory of SQL migration files applied in lexical order during provisioning

seed_command.description: Custom shell command executed in the manifest directory to seed the database

health_command.description: Custom shell command executed during health checks to validate database state

ingress.description: Declarative reverse proxy ingress routing configuration applied via netctl

provider.description: Target reverse proxy engine (nginx, caddy, apache, iis)

listen.description: Port or list of ports to listen on

routes.description: Routing table mapping URL prefixes to upstream proxies, WebSockets, or static/SPA directories

target.description: Upstream URL or local filesystem path

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks executed during installation, build, migration, and service startup/shutdown

build.description: Hooks executed during the build phase

db_migrate.description: Hooks executed to migrate database schemas

seed.description: Hooks executed to seed initial datasets into databases

health.description: Hooks executed during health checks to verify application and dataset integrity

ml.description: Declarative Machine Learning training and inference configuration across local and cloud accelerators

backend.description: ML framework or serving backend (jax, maxtext, pytorch, keras, mlx, vllm, ollama, jetstream)

etl_command.description: Command executed for ML ETL preprocessing
